## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and what changes for the user or caller.

## Validation

Record the actual commands, results, and environment. Explain any unavailable check.

- [ ] `python -m pytest`
- [ ] `python -m ruff check .`
- [ ] `python -m ruff format --check .`
- [ ] Relevant regression tests or interface checks added when needed

## Scientific scope and compatibility

Describe any change to inputs, initialization, clocks, geometry, state layout,
information availability, loss, or evaluation semantics. Distinguish manufactured
software controls from native-physics and real-data validation. State limitations
and any invalidated hashes or prior receipts; do not infer scientific acceptance
from a software test pass.

## Contribution checks

- [ ] No credentials, personal/server configuration, private data, weights, or run archives
- [ ] Original role/alias and evaluation information boundaries preserved, or a proposed change explained
- [ ] Existing MIT LICENSE and copyright notice preserved
- [ ] Any new code/data dependency has documented provenance and a compatible license
